decision.title: The Black Parade Is Dead!
tracklist: My Way Home Is Through You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (19 tracks) per Sonic Boom, TIDAL. Live album documenting the Black Parade World Tour concert in Mexico City, released June 30, 2008 (CD+DVD). Tracks 1-16 are the full live show; track 13 'The Black Parade Is Dead' is a title-card segment of the concert, not a song; tracks 17-19 are studio/B-side bonus tracks.
